freshness.rule: A ready record must have a parseable fresh_until later than evaluation time. Missing, expired, future-dated beyond bounded clock skew, malformed, or unavailable evidence cannot produce ready.

failure_behavior.summary_rule: The summary is ready only when every required dimension has current ready evidence. Any degraded dimension yields degraded; otherwise attention yields attention; otherwise any missing, stale, malformed, unavailable, or not-applicable required dimension yields unknown.

backup_coverage: The approved durable Memos state scope is explicitly defined.
A backup artifact exists and its integrity has been verified.
restore_capability: A clean-target restore has completed successfully.
Notes, relationships, tags, Spaces, attachments, and user-owned settings in the approved scope have been verified after restore.
recovery_freshness: Recovery evidence is current under the active Everkeep freshness policy.
portability: A clean-target re-import completes without undocumented loss.
migration: Supported database migration and upgrade paths pass exact-revision acceptance for the candidate.
documentation: Current backup, restore, limitations, and operator recovery documentation exists.
provenance: Recovery evidence is bound to an exact GoreeCloud Memos source revision and identifies the authoritative producer.
